pages.name: Main: Mini displays (MAX / PO2 / MOD, TEMP / CLOCK)

verified: Same badges, notifications and tank rules as the Perdix 2 (Peregrine TX manual Rev C p.21-26, p.56)

Info pages: the main screen with its bottom row replaced by one info screen - AI (T1 & GTR/SAC), MOD / MAX / PPO2, TEMP / CONSERV / CNS, GF99 / SurGF / CEIL, BATTERY, PRESSURE mBar SURF / NOW, DATE / CLOCK (Peregrine TX manual Rev C p.15 (row figure), p.16-20)
Gauge page: large depth and dive time, MAX / STOPWATCH, AVG, temperature, clock (Peregrine TX manual Rev C p.33)
Main screen top half: ascent-rate arrows beside the depth and the N2 loading bar beside the NDL, on every page but the gauge (Peregrine TX manual Rev C p.10-11)
Main screen bottom row as shipped: the gas, MAX in the centre, Mini Display 1 (TEMP over CLOCK) on the right (p.10, p.14)
Mini page: Mini Display 2 (MAX / PO2 / MOD) in the centre and Mini Display 1 on the right (p.14 figure)
Sidemount: T1 and T2 on the main screen with the green switch box on the tank to breathe from (p.41, 21 bar default), and the AI row T1 | GTR / SM / SAC | T2 (p.41 combination table)
assumed: Element placement from a pre-dive photo only; no live screen or log seen
Info and gauge positions measured from the manual's figures and set on the main page's skin
Gauge STOPWATCH shows the dive time: a log records no stopwatch start or reset
Info screens are shown in full, without the 10 s timeout; the date and clock are the log's own time (24 h)
Gauge page: the photo's TIME / NDL titles and dividers painted out, one divider under the top row
Mini page: the centre and right slots are set to the manual's example; on the device both are the diver's choice
Clock in 24 h (the manual's figures show am/pm)
not_shown: Info screens LAST DIVE (surface only), Compass (no heading in a log), TISSUES, DET / Δ+5 / @+5 / TTS (what-if values not computed), SERIAL NO / VERSION
CONSERV level name (Low / Med / High) above the GF pair, and the battery type / nominal voltage beside BATTERY: not in the logs
Gauge page: no notification row and no resettable average (deco is not tracked in gauge mode)
Three and four transmitters (T1-T4 on one row, p.41): the overlay knows two tanks
No Comms and Low Bat transmitter warnings (p.39): the logs drop the transmitter status
RTR (sidemount redundant time remaining, p.41) and Gas Density (p.14): not computed
notes._about: What this template reproduces of the real screen and what it does not; manual pages in hud_rules_sources.md
